label: models/fw_walllamp.mdl: a caged wall lamp with a sodium-orange glass

measured.lineup: ours is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/testsphere.mdl, models/gib_legbone.mdl, models/ribcage.mdl: the judge does not know which

M1.reason: The silhouette is a plain cube in all ten views (front, sides, top, below and the four corners). The brief asks for a caged wall lamp, so there is no cage, no glass housing and no mounting bracket. The outline is a box, not the lamp's.

M2.reason: Measured at 24 x 24 x 24, but the brief gives no size for the lamp (sizeAsked is null), so there is nothing to test the size against. It cannot reach 2 on a measure with no reference. Nothing else in the size is measurable.

M3.reason: None of the lamp's parts are present: no cage bars, no sodium-orange glass panel, no bracket or mount. The whole model is one solid block, so the parts the brief names are missing.

M4.reason: The whole model is a uniform grey concrete noise texture. The brief asks for a sodium-orange glass and a metal cage, and neither is there. Every region is wrong in colour and material.

M5.reason: The only surface detail is a grey mottled noise texture. There is no glow, no lit glass, no cage or panel lines, no wear or markings. None of the lamp's surface features are present.

M6.reason: Beside Half-Life's props in the line-up it reads as a generic grey cube. A player would not take it for a caged wall lamp, and the judge cannot pick it out as the lamp from the line-up.

M7.reason: A plain cube has no distinguishable front, and nothing shows a wall-mounting face or how it stands on its origin. Facing and placing cannot be checked against a lamp, so the item is clearly off, not wrong in a measured way.

M8.reason: SMAK's check reports no errors. The model has 12 triangles, far below the threshold of twice the median (62, so 124) or the third quartile (156). The box is closed and nothing is open, inside out or floating.
